subject: Post-call recap & Mutual Action Plan — Acme Map POC
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acme.com>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & Mutual Action Plan — Acme Map POC

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the 6-week PoC for Acme Map integration with Redwood Inference. Please review and confirm stakeholders/dates below.

Pain points we heard
- High per-token cost and inconsistent tail latency during peak map-rendering queries.
- Need for deterministic latency for end-user map interactions (95th pct target ~150ms).
- Security/compliance: customer data access must remain in Acme VPC during evaluation.

Goals for the PoC
- Demonstrate integration with Redwood’s hosted inference plus dedicated private VPC option.
- Show 30-40% cost improvement on typical query patterns and consistent 95th pct latency <= 150ms.
- Validate prefix caching and batching improvements on your top 10 query types.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (timeline & owners)
1) Kickoff & architecture review — Mar 22, 2027 — Owners: Marissa (Redwood) / Samir (Acme)
2) Data & access provisioning (S3 + service account + VPC peering test) — Mar 25-29 — Owner: Acme infra (Priya)
3) Integration sprint (API + SDK) — Mar 30–Apr 12 — Owner: Redwood eng (Vivek)
4) Security review & evidence exchange (SOC2, network docs) — Apr 5–12 — Owners: Acme Sec / Redwood Sec
5) Performance validation & cost report — Apr 13–16 — Owner: Redwood Analytics
6) Procurement/contract sign & go/no-go decision — Apr 20 — Owner: Acme Procurement (procure@acme.com)

Open questions / asks from your side
- Who will be the final decision-maker for the PoC (name + email)?
- Can we get S3 read-only creds + one engineering contact for the integration?
- Any internal procurement windows we should be aware of?

Attachments: redwood-map-poc-proposal-v1.pdf (proposal), acme-poc-scope.xlsx (detailed scope & acceptance criteria).

If the dates above look reasonable please confirm and we’ll lock the kickoff. Happy to move any milestones to match your procurement cadence.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@acme.com>, Acme Purchasing <procure@acme.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & Mutual Action Plan — Acme Map POC

Thanks Marissa — great write-up and aligned with what we discussed. A few notes from our side:

- Decision-maker: Priya Reddy (priya.reddy@acme.com) will sign off on the PoC and make the go/no-go recommendation.
- Proposed kickoff OK for Mar 22. Can we do a 9:30am PT sync (30-45 min) for the architecture walk-through?
- Data access: We can provision an S3 bucket and create a read-only service account by Mar 24.
- Security: Please send your SOC 2 summary & any network diagram we can share with Acme Sec.
- Procurement: Our purchasing team needs a one-page SOW + PO instructions. Looping in procure@acme.com.

I’ve attached a short internal checklist (no attachments in Gmail here — will share via Drive). For now, confirmed stakeholders: Priya (Decision), Sameer (Product), Noor (Infra lead — will be on the data access).

Next steps (from Acme)
1) Confirm kickoff 3/22 9:30am PT — Priya/Samir/Noor + Redwood leads
2) Provide S3 & service account by 3/24
3) Procurement to provide PO instructions after we confirm SOW

Samir
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp
